title: Balikatan 18: Para-rescue SME Exchange
description: Philippine and U.S. Air Force service members sit down for subject matter expert exchanges during Exercise Balikatan at Clark Air Base, Pampanga, Philippines, May 8, 2018. Exercise Balikatan, in its 34th iteration, is an annual U.S.-Philippine military training focused on a variety of missions, including humanitarian assistance and disaster relief, counterterrorism, and other combined military operations held from May 7 to May 18. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Ashley Adkins)
